{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify rows with commas in revenue (likely QA rows)
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)
qa_rows = df[has_commas]

print(f"Found {len(qa_rows)} rows with commas in revenue:")
print(qa_rows['revenue'].unique())

# Remove these rows
df_clean = df[~has_commas]

# Verify
print(f"Remaining rows after removing comma-containing revenue rows: {len(df_clean)}")

# Check that no row has '999999.99' in the string column
print(f"Any row with '999999.99' in revenue? {df_clean['revenue'].isin(['999999.99']).any()}")"}
